question: Dividing fiscal 2026 net sales by the number of warehouses open at year-end, how much did Costco sell per warehouse?
answer: Dividing fiscal 2026 net sales of $297,247,000,000 by 939 warehouses open at year-end, Costco sold approximately $316,557,082 per warehouse.

facts.label: Costco operated 939, 914, and 890 warehouses worldwide at August 30, 2026, August 31, 2025, and September 1, 2024.
